# Ecosystem summaries

Aim is to create ecosystem summary figures that are:

 - customisable
 - easily updatable
 
 
 "Developing `r colorize("tailored")` environmental indices enhances
 relevance" 
 
 Brodie et al. (2026, Rev. Fish Biol. Fish.)

## Restrict plot or data to an area

You can create our own fisheries management area (see vignette), such as:

```{r, sasquatchprimaryproduction}
primary_production <- bccm_primaryproduction_full()   

plot(primary_production, area = sasquatch, restrict_plot = FALSE, area_outline = sasquatch)
```

```{r, sasquatchwalking, fig.height = 6, out.width = "100%", eval = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
plot(primary_production, years = 2014:2016, months = 1:12, area = sasquatch, restrict_plot = TRUE, area_outline = sasquatch)
```

## Ecosystem summary heatmap for hake recruitment

index -- annual value of any pacea object (can be spatially
restricted)\
    then standardised by subtracting mean and dividing by standard
deviation


New **`create_index()`** function:
```{r, createindex}
hake_recruitment_index <- create_index(
  filter(hake_recruitment,
         year <= 2022),
  index_name = "hake_recruitment",
  index_label = "Pacific Hake age-0 recruitment")

start_year <- hake_recruitment_index$year[1]

herring_biomass_wcvi_index <- create_index(filter(herring_spawning_biomass,
                                                  year >= start_year),
                                           herring_region = "WCVI",
                                           index_name =
                                             "herring_spawning_biomass_wcvi")
```

## Ecosystem summary heatmap for hake recruitment

Resulting indices have consistent format:

```{r, showindices}
hake_recruitment_index

herring_biomass_wcvi_index
```

Create more based on Vestfals et al. (2023).

```{r, hake, echo = FALSE}
hake_assessment_year <- 2026
hake_recruitment_final_year_to_use <- 2022  # final years removed as not
            # estimated by data, depends on the model assumptions        
age_1_hake_final_year_to_use <- hake_recruitment_final_year_to_use + 1

hake_recruitment_index <- create_index(
  filter(hake_recruitment,
         year <= hake_recruitment_final_year_to_use),
  index_name = "hake_recruitment",
  index_label = "Pacific Hake age-0 recruitment")

start_year <- hake_recruitment_index$year[1]

pdo_index <- create_index(filter(pdo,
                                 year >= start_year),
                          months = 4:9,
                          index_name = "pdo_preconditioning",
                          index_label = "PDO Preconditioning")

npgo_index <- create_index(filter(npgo,
                                 year >= start_year),
                          months = 4:9,
                          index_name = "npgo_preconditioning",
                          index_label = "NPGO Preconditioning")

bi_index <- create_index(bi,
                         index_label = "Bifurcation Index")

herring_biomass_wcvi_index <- create_index(filter(herring_spawning_biomass,
                                                  year >= start_year),
                                           herring_region = "WCVI",
                                           index_name =
                                             "herring_spawning_biomass_wcvi")

hake_age_1_index <- create_index(filter(hake_total_biomass_age_1,
                                        year <= age_1_hake_final_year_to_use),
                                 index_name = "hake_age_1_total_biomass",
                                 index_label = "Pacific Hake age-1 biomass")
```

## Ecosystem summary heatmap for hake recruitment

```{r, hakeheatmapcode, eval = FALSE}
plot_indices(hake_recruitment_index,
             pdo_index,
             npgo_index,
             bi_index,             
             herring_biomass_wcvi_index,
             hake_age_1_index,
             years = 1995:2027,
             gap_after = c("hake_recruitment_index",
                           "bi_index",
                           "herring_biomass_wcvi_index"),
             flip = c("pdo_index",
                      "bi_index",
                      "herring_biomass_wcvi_index",
                      "hake_age_1_index"),
             shift = c("pdo_index",
                       "npgo_index",
                       "bi_index",
                       "herring_biomass_wcvi_index"),
             text_size = 2)
```

## Ecosystem summary heatmap for hake recruitment

```{r, hakeheatmap, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 12, out.width = "95%", echo = FALSE}
plot_indices(hake_recruitment_index,
             pdo_index,
             npgo_index,
             bi_index,             
             herring_biomass_wcvi_index,
             hake_age_1_index,
             years = 1995:2027,    # else a bit unwieldy to see
             gap_after = c("hake_recruitment_index",
                           "bi_index",
                           "herring_biomass_wcvi_index"),
             flip = c("pdo_index",
                      "bi_index",
                      "herring_biomass_wcvi_index",
                      "hake_age_1_index"),
             shift = c("pdo_index",
                       "npgo_index",
                       "bi_index",
                       "herring_biomass_wcvi_index"),
             text_size = 2) 
```

`*` colours are flipped so `r colorize("red")` is always ‘good for hake’

`+` year shifted by one due to lag of effect

## Quick summary for Strait of Georgia

```{r, examplessummary, echo = FALSE}
# Average sea surface temperature in April from a buoy in the SOG
sst_buoy_halibut_bank_apr_index <- create_index(buoy_sst,
                                                months = 4,
                                                stn_id = "Halibut Bank")

# Large calanoid copepods in the SOG 
calanoid_copepods_large_sog_index <- create_index(zooplankton_sog,
                                                  zooplankton_species_group =
                                                    "calanoid_copepods_large")

# Total zooplankton in the SOG
total_zooplankton_sog_index <- create_index(zooplankton_sog,
                                            zooplankton_species_group = "total_biomass")

# Annual age-2 herring recruitment in the SOG
herring_recruitment_sog_index <- create_index(herring_recruitment,
                                              herring_region = "SOG")

# Annual herring spawning biomass in the SOG
herring_biomass_sog_index <- create_index(herring_spawning_biomass,
                                          herring_region = "SOG")

# Annual population estimates of Harbour Seals in the SOG
harbour_seals_sog_index <- create_index(harbour_seals,
                                        seal_region = "SOG")
```


```{r, sogplot, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 12, out.width = "95%", echo = FALSE}
plot_indices(sst_buoy_halibut_bank_apr_index,
             calanoid_copepods_large_sog_index,
             total_zooplankton_sog_index,
             herring_recruitment_sog_index,
             herring_biomass_sog_index,             
             harbour_seals_sog_index,
             years = 1996:2026,
             gap_after = c("sst_buoy_halibut_bank_apr_index",
                           "total_zooplankton_sog_index",
                           "herring_biomass_sog_index"))
```
